title: Swarm lane event
description: One append-only JSONL record per swarm-stream lifecycle event, written to .swarms/events/<stream-id>.jsonl by post-bash-log.sh (lane.red/green/blocked) and subagent-stop.sh (lane.finished). Coordinator tails these to drive merge decisions (Spec 001 AC-17).

event.description: Lane lifecycle transition. red/green mirror the TDD ledger; blocked marks a [b] task; started/finished bracket the stream.

payload.description: Event-specific detail (task id, exit code, error signature, etc.). Shape is event-dependent and intentionally open.
